title: Dev 環境部署管線 — AWS RDS + Amplify Staging Branch
content:
Set up a full dev deployment environment on AWS for internal testing before merging to production.

Currently all environments (dev/staging/prod) share the same production RDS (lmc-cpd-database.chyqcssmq6u2.ap-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com) and there is no dedicated dev branch deployment. This means all code changes must be tested against production data, which is risky and prevents destructive testing.

Requirements:
1. **Dev RDS**: Provision a separate AWS RDS PostgreSQL instance (e.g. db.t4g.micro, low-cost tier) for dev/staging use
2. **Amplify staging branch**: Configure an Amplify staging branch (e.g. `dev` branch) that auto-deploys on push, using the dev RDS
3. **Dev env vars**: Create DATABASE_URL_DEV (or env-specific naming), set in Amplify Console for the staging branch
4. **Security**: Dev DB security group allows access from Amplify staging branch only (not 0.0.0.0/0); no production data in dev DB — seed with test/synthetic data only
5. **Docs**: Update AGENTS.md and .env.example with the dev environment setup instructions
6. **URL**: Dev deployment accessible at a distinct URL (e.g. https://dev.lmc-cpd.example.com or Amplify auto-assigned domain) for internal QA team to test
